title: Spamton G. Spamton
subtitle: Frat bestie. [Recipe enthusiast]. Speaks in brackets.

quote.text: Well its good that your out habibi, pop up to [CYBERR1!! C1TYY!!] When you get there chance

lead:
**Spamton G. Spamton** is a voice on the other end of [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]'s [[windows-phone|Windows phone]], and, by MF Vroom's own account, his “bestie” from his fraternity days at [[darkworld-state-university|Darkworld State University]]. He is one of very few characters in the canon to be introduced entirely over the phone, and the only one who speaks partly in [BRACKETS].

Spamton calls during the hyperspace flight from [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]] to [[the-projects|the Projects]] in [[chapter-4-point-1]], requests a highly specific culinary favour, and hangs up. He has not been seen in person.

sections.heading: The phone call
sections.body:
As the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] crosses hyperspace, MF Vroom's [[peter-griffin-ringtone|Peter Griffin]] ringtone interrupts [[rfk|RFK]]'s explanation of the mission. The caller opens with “MF, bro you out?”, and on learning that MF Vroom is headed back to [[united-state-of-america|the United States Of America]] to defeat [[chris|Chris]], he makes his request:

> “Well that’s splendid, listen if on the way you find any intergalactic road kill please for the love of [TON 618] cut off its [orb shaped objects] and bring it back for me so I can try this new recipe I’ve been wanting to try, grogu told me it on this wild lsd trip I had, twas fire bruh”

He signs off with an invitation to “pop up to [CYBERR1!! C1TYY!!] When you get there chance” and the blessing “good luck we’re all counting on yall gucci gang”.

MF Vroom answers only “Noted”. Whether he intends to collect the [orb shaped objects] is not recorded.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: When RFK asks “Who was that-t?”, MF Vroom explains that Spamton was his frat brother in [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]] (“something that sounded like that”). Part of the frat's hazing was packaging [[xp-candy|XP candy]] for the higher-ups, which earned “so much [kromer]” (see [[kromer|Kromer]]). MF Vroom sums him up as “good guy”.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Spamton G. Spamton is a salesman character from the video game *Deltarune*. He talks in bracketed, glitchy phrases, which explains [TON 618], [orb shaped objects] and [CYBERR1!! C1TYY!!].
- [[cyber-city|Cyber City]], [[kromer|Kromer]] and the “Darkworld” in Darkworld State University are all *Deltarune* references too.
- [[ton-618|TON 618]] is used here as an oath, “for the love of [TON 618]”, a few pages before the robot of that name appears. The book never says whether Spamton is swearing by the robot or the robot was named after the oath.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Spamton calls MF Vroom “habibi” and the whole team “gucci gang” in the same call.
- [[rfk|RFK]] wants roadkill of his own later in the chapter (see [[spaceport-chase]]). Two separate characters looking for roadkill recipes within a few pages is something fans have noticed and nobody has explained.
- Spamton is the only person known to have heard a recipe from [[grogu|Grogu]].

title: Grogu
lead:
**Grogu** is a culinary source quoted second-hand by [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]]. According to Spamton, Grogu told him a recipe calling for the [orb shaped objects] of intergalactic roadkill, and Spamton now wants [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] to bring him some so he can try it:

> “grogu told me it on this wild lsd trip I had, twas fire bruh”

Grogu does not appear in person, and the sentence leaves open whether he was really there or was part of the trip. Some fans think he was a hallucination. Others note that Spamton calls the recipe “fire”, so whatever Grogu is, the recipe works.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Grogu (widely known as “Baby Yoda”) is a character from the *Star Wars* series *The Mandalorian*. He sits alongside the canon's other Star Wars material, such as [[lightsaber|lightsabers]], [[jedi|the Jedi]] and [[galactic-senate|the Galactic Senate]].
- He is the only *Star Wars* character in the book who is credited with a recipe.

title: TON 618
subtitle: Flagship defence of the Projects. Looking for the wrong car.

infobox.Type: Monolithically sized defensive bio-robotic weapons robot
infobox.Creator: [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]]

quote.text: It stands for Terrible Offensive Nuhuh.

lead: **TON 618** (“Terrible Offensive Nuhuh”) is a giant bio-robotic war machine housed in [[dpf-facility-69420|DPF Facility 69420]]. It is the flagship of [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]]'s [[ton-robots|TON robots]] and the main defence of [[the-projects|the Projects]]. [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]] calls it the most infamous of them all. At the end of [[chapter-4-point-1]] it activates and starts searching the city for the heroes.

sections.heading: Description
sections.body:
Son introduces it while the gang drives toward [[o-block|O'Block]]:

> “In the begining of the O’block 2 era, when It was being scaled to be a EU level nation, Osama Bin’ Bombin created monolithically sized defensive bio-robotic weapons robots.. the most infamous of which is.. the one in that facility, facility 69420, TON six eighteen. It stands for Terrible Offensive Nuhuh. Its the projects flagship defense like Israel’s iron dome but as one big robotic creature.. yall we might be screwed, Osama does not want us here”

TON 618 has the following known features:
- A faint blue glow, visible from far away.
- A “giant robotic roar” that can be heard “from horizon to horizon”.
- Footsteps that make the ground rumble.
- A “large red electronic eye, maybe not a eye, more like a giant spotlight” that sweeps the buildings and roads.

sections.heading: Activation
sections.body: The faint glow from the facility first prompts the question of whether [[ninja|Ninja aka Tyler Blevins]] has joined the [[fortnite|Fortnite]] lobby. Then the roar sounds and the doors of the DPF open. At the end of the chapter TON 618 is walking through the city “looking for the Camry”, while robotic screeches are heard “from horizon to horizon”.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- **The Camry.** TON 618 is searching for “the Camry”, but the heroes are driving [[honda-accord-2005|Son's 2005 Honda Accord]]. The book never says whether this is an error in the book or in TON 618's targeting. Either way the robot is looking for the wrong car. The canon's other car mix-ups are listed under [[toyota-corolla|the Toyota Corolla Question]].
- **Offensive defence.** TON 618 is described as a *defensive* system, yet the name stands for Terrible *Offensive* Nuhuh.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- In real life, TON 618 is one of the largest known black holes. Within the canon the name is also used as an oath: [[spamton|Spamton]] says “for the love of [TON 618]” earlier in the same chapter.
- “Nuhuh” recalls [[bon-jovi|Bon Jovi]]'s famous answer in [[nuh-uh-debate|the Great Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate]]. Fans have suggested the robot was named in its honour. This is a fan theory.
- The comparison to Israel's Iron Dome missile-defence system comes from Son.

title: Cyber City
lead:
**Cyber City**, written in the canon as **[CYBERR1!! C1TYY!!]**, is a place [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]] invites [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] to visit:

> “Well its good that your out habibi, pop up to [CYBERR1!! C1TYY!!] When you get there chance”

That is everything the book says about it. Its location, its population and its spelling outside brackets are all unknown. The invitation suggests Spamton lives there or at least spends time there.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Cyber City is a major area in Chapter 2 of *Deltarune*, the same game Spamton comes from. The extra letters and numbers copy the way Spamton's speech glitches in that game.
- As of [[chapter-4-point-1]], MF Vroom has not taken up the offer. He is busy.

title: Darkworld State University
lead:
**Darkworld State University** is the university where [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] earned his degree in business. It is also where he met his frat bestie [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]]:

> “Someone I met while I was getting my degree in business from Darkworld State University, he was my bestie from my days in a fraternity”

The university's one known fraternity is [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]] (or “something that sounded like that”). The frat ran a [[xp-candy|XP candy]] packaging operation that paid in [[kromer|kromer]].

sections.heading: Significance
sections.body: This passage is the only account of MF Vroom's education. Before it, readers knew him as a long-lost relative of [[projects-royal-family|the Projects royal family]], an exile in the [[call-of-duty-lobbies|COD lobbies]], and a car wearing a robe. The business degree may explain how he and [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] later brought [[o-block|O'Block]] “to its glory”. This is a fan theory.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- The “Dark World” is the setting of *Deltarune*, the same game Spamton comes from.
- Darkworld State is one of two universities in the canon. The other is [[koolaid-college|Koolaid College]], [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]]'s alma mater, which makes Osama and MF Vroom rivals from different schools as well as everything else.

title: Alpha Mogger Beta
lead: **Alpha Mogger Beta** is the fraternity [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] and [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]] belonged to at [[darkworld-state-university|Darkworld State University]]. Even its name is uncertain: MF Vroom remembers it as “I think it was Alpha Mogger Beta, something that sounded like that.”

sections.heading: Activities
sections.body:
According to MF Vroom, the frat had “this whole drug operation going”:

> “part of our hazing ritual was helping the higher ups in the frat package xp candy, we made so much [kromer] from that man it was the high life, sometimes we even got to snort some ourselves.”

The fraternity's hazing therefore consisted of packaging [[xp-candy|XP candy]], and it was paid in [[kromer|kromer]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The name takes the Greek letters Alpha and Beta and puts “[[mogging|Mogger]]” between them.
- The canon's alpha/beta theme comes back in the same chapter. [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]] calls his arrest attempt “official Alpha male business” and then gets turned into “a beta male”.
- It is the second frat in the canon. [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]] belonged to [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]] at [[koolaid-college|Koolaid College]], and its “frat bros rose up” in [[oblock-coup|the O'Block Coup]]. Fans read the coup as a frat rivalry that got out of hand. This is a fan theory.

title: XP Candy
lead:
**XP candy** was the product behind [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]]'s campus business at [[darkworld-state-university|Darkworld State University]]. Pledges, [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] among them, were hazed by being made to package it for the higher-ups. The business made “so much [kromer]”, and MF Vroom adds that “sometimes we even got to snort some ourselves.”

What XP candy actually does is never explained. The name suggests it gives experience points.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Pokémon has “Exp. Candy” items that give a Pokémon experience. Fans think the name comes from there. This is a fan theory.
- XP candy is one of several substances the canon handles casually, next to [[galaxy-gas|galaxy gas]], [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dew]] and [[purple-juice|solidified purple juice]].

title: Kromer
lead:
**Kromer**, always written in brackets as **[kromer]**, is the currency [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]] earned from its [[xp-candy|XP candy]] operation:

> “we made so much [kromer] from that man it was the high life”

It joins a canon economy that also runs on dollar-denominated [[fortnite|Fortnite]] cards and [[nfts|NFTs]].

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- In *Deltarune*, Kromer is the currency of [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]], and it is written in brackets because that is how he talks. In the canon MF Vroom puts it in brackets as well, so it seems Spamton's style has rubbed off on him.
- The exchange rate between kromer and [[the-projects|Projects]] money is unknown.

title: Peter Griffin
lead:
**Peter Griffin** appears in the canon as a ringtone. When [[spamton|Spamton]] calls [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] during the hyperspace flight, the phone plays Peter singing:

> “the ring tone was Peter griffin singing some choir something, they couldn’t tell what beautiful melody was coming out of his windows phone.”

Nobody on board can identify the song. Whether the real Peter Griffin was involved in recording it, and whether he is paid for it, is unknown.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Peter Griffin is the main character of *Family Guy*. That makes him the second *Family Guy* character in the canon, after [[quagmire|Quagmire]].
- Fans have guessed the song is one of Peter's famous musical numbers from the show. This is a fan theory, since the text only calls it “some choir something”.
- The ringtone interrupts “the middle of their speech” about [[wemby-curry-bronny|playing Wemby, Curry, even Bronny]], so nobody gets to finish the explanation.

title: MF Vroom's Windows Phone
lead:
**MF Vroom's Windows phone** is the personal phone of [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]. It rings with a [[peter-griffin-ringtone|Peter Griffin]] ringtone during the hyperspace jump to [[the-projects|the Projects]], and the caller is [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]].

It is unusual among the canon's phones because nobody claims it has any special powers. The [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] is an anti-deity protocol, the [[nokia-i-4500|Nokia I-4500]] is the subject of an ancient requirement, and the [[t1-phones|T1 phones]] belong to the Kirks. The Windows phone just rings.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- MF Vroom had just escaped the [[call-of-duty-lobbies|COD lobbies]] and the [[chambers-360|360 chambers]]. It is not explained how his phone still had signal or battery.
- Windows phones were made by Microsoft, which also makes [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]], the owner of the [[the-67-casino|6 7 Casino]].
- Fans have asked whether the phone could hold [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]]'s apps. The book does not consider this. This is a fan theory.

title: Adirondack Park

infobox.Region: New York, [[united-state-of-america|The United State of America]]
infobox.Notable event: Cruiser exits hyperspace through the treetops

lead:
**Adirondack Park** is where the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] comes out of hyperspace on the way to [[the-projects|the Projects]]. The exit is a rough one:

> “With a goose on the windshield and leaves on their wings the Mercedes Benz System Cruiser was cruising through the treetops of Adirondack park.”

When a window is opened, “the brisk breeze of a new york morning” blows through the cabin. The ship then makes “a slow long turn, as fast as you could turn at mach 3”, which [[plankton|Plankton]] explains will line them up with [[projects-national-spaceport|the Projects National Spaceport]], “pretty dope pog if you ask me.”

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Adirondack Park is a real, very large park in upstate New York. It is one of the few real places in the canon that sits where it does in the real world.
- The goose's fate is not recorded.
- Because of this scene, fans place the Projects somewhere within mach 3 turning distance of New York. This is a fan theory.

title: The United State of America
lead:
**The United State of America**, singular, is the destination the heroes set course for when they leave the [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]] sector:

> “As they flew back out of the dunder mifflin sector they set course for The United State of America, specifically the projects.”

It contains [[the-projects|the Projects]], [[adirondack-park|Adirondack Park]] and, presumably, New York. A few lines later [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] tells [[spamton|Spamton]] they are “headed back to the United States Of America”, plural, so the number of states is disputed even within one chapter.

sections.heading: Geography
sections.body: The Projects are in “the americas not Europe”, as MF Vroom points out when he refuses to let [[o-block|O'Block]] join [[european-union|the EU]]. This makes the United State of America one of the few places in the canon whose continent is confirmed. By contrast, [[moscow|Moscow]] is an Italian city and [[canada|Canada]] has a Roman emperor.

sections.heading: Continuity
sections.body:
- The origin story sends “the baller army of the united states of a america” (see [[baller-army|Baller Army]]), which is a third spelling.
- The canon also has [[united-streets-of-ohio|the United Streets of Ohio]] and the “United Multiverses”. It is not known how many of these are united with each other.

title: The Projects National Spaceport
lead: **The Projects National Spaceport** is the main spaceport of [[the-projects|the Projects]] and the place where the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] lands in [[chapter-4-point-1]]. [[plankton|Plankton]] lines the ship up with it from [[adirondack-park|Adirondack Park]] with a mach 3 turn, and the crew lands after “a hour or two of practicing [[mogging|mogging]]”.

sections.heading: Events
sections.body:
At the bottom of the ramp the crew is met by [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]], ambassador of [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]], who tries to arrest [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] for coming back from exile. [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]], who has been hiding among the janitorial staff, shoots him with a [[modded-colonial-musket|modded colonial musket]].

The gang then goes “straight through spaceport security, muskets firing, light sabers slicing, their body count was going crazy” and escapes through the front doors with [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]] chasing them. See [[spaceport-chase|The Spaceport Breakout & O'Block Chase]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Outside the spaceport the streets are lined with “Brick buildings and sketchy gas stations”.
- The spaceport's security did not catch an armed musketeer working on its own janitorial staff. Fans have pointed out the hiring problem.

title: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
subtitle: Ambassador. Wooden. Briefly a beta male.

quote.text: Sir this is official Alpha male business

lead: **Tung Tung Tung Sahur**, also called **Triple T**, is the ambassador of [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] for [[the-projects|the Projects]]. He has a wooden body. He meets the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] at [[projects-national-spaceport|the Projects National Spaceport]], and the narrator calls this “a big deal”.

sections.heading: Attempted arrest
sections.body:
Triple T tells [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]:

> “MF Vroom.. it is not very poggers for you to come back after you were explicitly sent into exile, we’re gonna have to arrest you”

While [[plankton|Plankton]] and [[rfk|RFK]] run back to the ship for their modded nerf guns, a dark figure comes out of the janitorial staff. Triple T insists “Sir this is official Alpha male business” and then “Sir cursing is strictly prohibited” (in response to “GG fricken easy”). The figure turns out to be [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]]. Triple T's last word is a whimpered “.. Son?”, and then a [[modded-colonial-musket|musket]] pellet goes “right through his wooden body and incapacitated him.”

sections.heading: Status
sections.body:
Triple T is not dead, or at least will not stay that way. Son explains:

> “That’ll only have him being a beta male until his death pose starts mogging, then he’ll be back”

His return therefore depends on how much his death pose [[mogging|mogs]]. When the crew leaves he is still on the floor. Plankton calls the situation “that fat L issue”, now sorted.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a wooden, bat-carrying character from the “Italian brainrot” internet meme trend, which is why his body is wooden.
- He holds an ambassador's title while living in the country he is ambassador for. How this works is not explained.

title: Son S. Sonionring
subtitle: Right-hand man. Janitor (undercover). Forgotten in the prologue.

quote.text: Sonion ring you just made a big mistake.

lead:
**Son S. Sonionring** (also spelled **SonionRing**, and called **Son** or **Sonion**) is [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]'s right-hand man and the co-builder of [[o-block|O'Block]]'s golden age. He enters the canon in [[chapter-4-point-1]], and the narrator immediately admits to leaving him out of the earlier chapters:

> “We forgot to mention this in the prologue but Son S. Sonionring was MF Vroom’s right hand man.”

He is a good shot with a [[modded-colonial-musket|modded colonial musket]], drives a [[honda-accord-2005|2005 Honda Accord]] fitted with a machine gun, and owns a car stereo his speakers have learned to fear.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body:
When MF Vroom was exiled by [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]], Son “went into hiding... in fear that he too would have to listen to xbox live 2009 lobbies until his end”. Before that, he says, he and MF Vroom “worked together to bring the O’block to its glory.”

He was not there for [[oblock-coup|the O'Block Coup]]:

> “That day I was at my sisters wedding, If I were there everything would be different pogchamp.”

sections.heading: Spaceport ambush
sections.body:
Son goes undercover among the janitorial staff of [[projects-national-spaceport|the Projects National Spaceport]]. When [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]] moves to arrest MF Vroom, Son comes forward with a muttered “Son”, then “GG fricken easy”, then “Fricken easy.” He cocks his musket, lifts his hood, and says:

> “Sonion ring you just made a big mistake.”

He drops Triple T with one shot and answers MF Vroom's shocked “Son?!” with “At your service sir”.

sections.heading: The chase
sections.body:
During [[spaceport-chase|the breakout]], Son shouts “Quick hop in my whip cuh!” and does “a completely unnecessary burn out” in the Accord. While being chased by [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]] he reaches across [[rfk|RFK]] (“invaded RFK’s person space”) into the glove box. Something clicks, and a machine gun comes out of the trunk firing [[purple-juice|solidified purple juice]] that pops every tire chasing them. He also puts on [[i-cant-put-down-the-cup|“I Can't Put Down the Cup”]] at a volume that makes his speakers beg for mercy.

When RFK asks for roadkill, Son answers: “man bruh we already running from the cops why you wanna cook up some new Kennedy food”.

sections.heading: Lore contributions
sections.body: Son explains a large part of the Projects' recent history. He covers the coup by the [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]] frat, the demand that O'Block join [[european-union|the EU]], the O'Block 2 era, and the creation of [[ton-robots|the TON robots]], including [[ton-618|TON 618]] (“yall we might be screwed”).

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- His name puts the word “Son” in front of “Sonionring”. The middle initial is not explained.
- Son is apparently the only person able to tell MF Vroom's story in order, which makes the prologue's failure to mention him stand out even more.
- He introduces himself properly only after the cops have been lost: “I Don’t believe I’ve introduced myself properly... I doubt any of you know how baller I am.”

title: The Modded Colonial Musket
lead:
**The Modded Colonial Musket** is the weapon of [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]]. He takes it out at [[projects-national-spaceport|the Projects National Spaceport]] and cocks it before shooting [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]]:

> “The musket pellet went right through his wooden body and incapacitated him.”

The modifications are not described. Whatever they are, a single pellet goes straight through a wooden ambassador.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.body: During [[spaceport-chase|the breakout]] the narration mentions “muskets firing”, in the plural. This suggests either more than one musket or one musket being fired very quickly. Muskets are the second most common firearm in the canon's Projects arc, behind [[rfk|RFK]] and [[plankton|Plankton]]'s modded nerf guns, which they run back to the ship to fetch and then never use.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- It is one of several old-fashioned weapons in the canon, along with [[lightsaber|lightsabers]] and [[metal-folding-chair|Plankton's metal folding chair]].
- “Colonial” may be a nod to the colonial history of the [[united-state-of-america|United State of America]]. This is a fan theory.

title: Son's 2005 Honda Accord

quote.text: Quick hop in my whip cuh!

lead: **Son's 2005 Honda Accord** (his “whip”) is the getaway car of [[spaceport-chase|the Spaceport Breakout]]. With [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]] chasing them out of [[projects-national-spaceport|the Projects National Spaceport]], [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] shouts “Quick hop in my whip cuh!”, and the gang gets in to the sound of “*Skrrrt*” as Son does “a completely unnecessary burn out.”

sections.heading: Seating
sections.body: According to the book: [[plankton|Plankton]] and [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]] in the back, Son driving, and [[rfk|RFK]] in shotgun. [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] is not listed. Since MF Vroom is himself a car (“a fuckig car wearing a robe”), some fans think he drove alongside. This is a fan theory.

sections.heading: Armament
sections.body:
The Accord has a hidden weapon. Son reaches into the glove box, there is “something like a click”, and:

> “suddenly a machine gun appeared out of the trunk. As son stepped on the throttle the machine gun started firing. Little pellets of solidified purple juice shot at the cars and popped all of the tires”

The narrator stresses that “it was magnificent how many tires were popped it was truly amazing you should’ve been there.” The car stereo plays [[i-cant-put-down-the-cup|“I Can't Put Down the Cup”]] the whole time.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- When [[ton-618|TON 618]] starts searching the city, it looks “for the Camry”. The gang is in a Honda Accord.
- Earlier in the same chapter, Plankton asks the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] “why r u built like a 2008 Honda accord Zyn weed addition”. That makes two Accords from two different model years in one chapter.
- See also [[toyota-corolla|the Toyota Corolla Question]], since [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] is canonically a Corolla.

title: Solidified Purple Juice
lead:
**Solidified purple juice** is the ammunition of the trunk-mounted machine gun in [[honda-accord-2005|Son's 2005 Honda Accord]]. During [[spaceport-chase|the O'Block chase]] it fires “Little pellets of solidified purple juice” at the [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]], which “popped all of the tires”.

How the juice is solidified, what flavour it is, and whether it can be turned back into juice are not covered by the canon.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body:
- Because the juice is purple and [[i-cant-put-down-the-cup|“I Can't Put Down the Cup”]] is playing at the same moment, some fans link it to the lean that [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]] sips from his utility belt. This is a fan theory.
- Others link it to [[koolaid-college|Koolaid College]], even though that is the enemy's school. This is a fan theory.

title: "I Can't Put Down the Cup"
lead:
**“I Can't Put Down the Cup”** (written in the book as “I Can’t put down the Cup”) is the song [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] plays on the stereo of his [[honda-accord-2005|2005 Honda Accord]] while being chased by the [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]]:

> “As all of this was happening Son had put “I Can’t put down the Cup” on the car stereo and started making his speakers beg for mercy.”

It is the getaway music of [[spaceport-chase|the O'Block Chase]]. The artist is not credited.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- It is one of several songs in the canon, alongside [[laugh-exe|Laugh.exe]], [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]], U2 playing on loop on the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]], and whatever [[peter-griffin-ringtone|Peter Griffin]] was singing.
- The speakers survived. The narrator only says they begged.

title: The Spaceport Breakout & O'Block Chase

infobox.Combatants: [[new-crips|New Crips]] and Son vs. spaceport security and [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]]
infobox.Weapons: Muskets, lightsabers, purple juice machine gun

lead: **The Spaceport Breakout & O'Block Chase** is the action sequence in [[chapter-4-point-1]] in which the [[new-crips|New Crips]], newly joined by [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]], fight their way out of [[projects-national-spaceport|the Projects National Spaceport]] and drive to [[o-block|O'Block]] with the police chasing them. It is the canon's first car chase, unless you count [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]]'s whole life.

sections.heading: Prelude
sections.body: After Son incapacitates [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]], Son warns: “We have to move quick, Osama knows we’re here, Quickly we have to get to the grand apartment complex where Osama lives”. When asked where that is, the answer is “O Block 2”.

sections.heading: The breakout
sections.body:
> “and they started running, straight through spaceport security, muskets firing, light sabers slicing, their body count was going crazy.”

They crash through the front doors with [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]] behind them, onto streets of “Brick buildings and sketchy gas stations”.

sections.heading: The chase
sections.body:
The gang gets into [[honda-accord-2005|Son's 2005 Honda Accord]]. The Police Kirks then “transformed into police cars and crashed through the front of the building”. In the middle of the chase, [[rfk|RFK]] asks:

> “How far i-is o block, is there road kill here I need raccon ******** for my next dish- *a road bump interrupted him* I-it is extremely important”

Son replies, “man bruh we already running from the cops why you wanna cook up some new Kennedy food”. He then reaches into the glove box, which brings a machine gun out of the trunk. It fires [[purple-juice|solidified purple juice]] and pops every tire chasing them, while [[i-cant-put-down-the-cup|“I Can't Put Down the Cup”]] plays. After that it is “smooth sailing to O’block.”

sections.heading: Casualties
sections.body: The body count is officially “going crazy”. No exact figure is given, so this is one of the few battles in the canon with no casualty number. Compare “over 10 casualties” in [[baller-army-attack|the Dabbing of the Haters]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- RFK's roadkill request is the second in the chapter, after [[spamton|Spamton]]'s request for intergalactic roadkill [orb shaped objects].
- The Police Kirks are the transforming, law-enforcement version of the [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]] from [[casino-heist|the Casino Heist]].

title: O'Block (O Block 2)
subtitle: Brought to glory. Taken by frat bros. Scaled to EU level.
lead: **O'Block**, also written **O Block** and in its later form called **O Block 2**, is the grand apartment complex at the centre of [[the-projects|the Projects]], and in a sense the nation itself. It is the home of [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]], who took it over in [[oblock-coup|the O'Block Coup]]. At the end of [[chapter-4-point-1]] it is where the heroes are heading.

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
### The golden age
According to [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]], he and [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] “worked together to bring the O’block to its glory. But our success was short lived, Once O’block had a nation around it the frat bros rose up”. MF Vroom lived there in a palace with a porch.

### The coup
[[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]] and his [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]] frat came to MF Vroom's porch and demanded that O'Block join [[european-union|the EU]]. MF Vroom refused because “the Projects are in the americas not Europe”, so they stormed the palace and took complete control. See [[oblock-coup|The O'Block Coup]].

### The O'Block 2 era
Under Osama, O'Block entered “the O’block 2 era, when It was being scaled to be a EU level nation”. In this period Osama built [[ton-robots|the TON robots]], including [[ton-618|TON 618]].

sections.heading: Features
sections.body:
- **The grand apartment complex** where Osama lives.
- **The palace**, where “The ssd would still be”. This is the [[microsd-card|67GB MicroSD card]] holding [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]].
- **[[projects-national-archives|The Projects National Archives]]**, which, according to MF Vroom and Son, also holds Facebook (Pre-Cringe). Whether the archives are inside the palace is unclear.
- Towering **defensive processing facilities**, including [[dpf-facility-69420|DPF Facility 69420]].

sections.heading: Current status
sections.body: At the end of [[chapter-4-point-1]], the heroes have decided not to retake the Projects outright (“the TON’s are going to level the city with us chuds in it”). Instead they plan to sneak in during [[chicken-hour|chicken hour]], take Facebook, and “dip before we start tweaking twin.” The last line of the canon so far is “Computah locate Facebook…”

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- O'Block is the nickname of a real housing block on Chicago's South Side, made famous by drill music.
- O Block 2 is never referred to as a sequel in the in-universe sense. Nobody mentions an O Block 1 except through the “O’block” of the golden age.

title: The O'Block Coup

infobox.Result: Osama takes complete control; MF Vroom exiled

lead: **The O'Block Coup** was the seizure of [[o-block|O'Block]] and its palace by [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] and his fraternity brothers. It ended the rule of [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] over [[the-projects|the Projects]]. The only account of it comes from [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]] in [[chapter-4-point-1]].

sections.heading: Account
sections.body:
> “Once O’block had a nation around it the frat bros rose up, One in particular… Osama Bin Bomb’in. He was a frat member of the Pol Phi Doros with Koolaid College. One day they showed up on Vrooms porch and demanded that the O’block join the EU. When MF’Vroom declined because the Projects are in the americas not Europe they stormed his palace and gained complete control.”

Son was not present: “That day I was at my sisters wedding, If I were there everything would be different pogchamp.”

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body:
- MF Vroom was exiled, “to forever get yelled at in COD lobbies” (see [[call-of-duty-lobbies|Call of Duty Lobbies]]).
- Son went into hiding among the [[projects-national-spaceport|spaceport]] janitorial staff.
- O'Block entered the O Block 2 era and was scaled up to an EU-level nation even though it never joined [[european-union|the EU]].
- Osama built [[ton-robots|the TON robots]].

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body: In [[chapter-2]], MF Vroom is exiled at I-38 West by Osama while working as a guide for [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve from Minecraft]] and [[quagmire|Quagmire]], with no palace or frat involved. Son's account mentions a stormed palace and nothing about guiding. The fan consensus is that both are true, since it was a busy day.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - The coup was carried out by [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]] of [[koolaid-college|Koolaid College]]. MF Vroom was in [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]] at [[darkworld-state-university|Darkworld State]].

title: The EU
lead:
**The EU** is a political union that [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] and his frat wanted [[o-block|O'Block]] to join. [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] said no because “the Projects are in the americas not Europe”, which was the immediate cause of [[oblock-coup|the O'Block Coup]].

After the coup, O'Block never formally joined. Under Osama it was instead “scaled to be a EU level nation” in the O Block 2 era. This suggests Osama wanted membership less than he wanted the size.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- MF Vroom's objection is one of the canon's rare arguments based on real geography, in a setting where [[moscow|Moscow]] is Italian and [[constantinople|Constantinople]] is ruled by [[barack-empire|the Barack Empire]].
- The EU's response to the demand is not recorded.

title: Pol Phi Doros
lead: **Pol Phi Doros** is the fraternity [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] belonged to at [[koolaid-college|Koolaid College]]. According to [[son-s-sonionring|Son]], once [[o-block|O'Block]] “had a nation around it the frat bros rose up, One in particular… Osama”. The frat then showed up on [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]'s porch and later stormed his palace in [[oblock-coup|the O'Block Coup]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- It is the canon's second fraternity, after [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]] (MF Vroom's). The two frats are on opposite sides of the Projects' politics.
- The name looks like Greek letters but only partly is. “Phi” is real. Fans have suggested “Doros” comes from Doritos, which are everywhere in the canon. This is a fan theory.

title: Koolaid College
lead:
**Koolaid College** is [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]]'s college, where he was a member of the [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]] fraternity. It gets one mention, in [[son-s-sonionring|Son]]'s account of [[oblock-coup|the O'Block Coup]]: “He was a frat member of the Pol Phi Doros with Koolaid College.”

Nothing else is known about the college, including its location, mascot or whether it offers business degrees comparable to those of its counterpart, [[darkworld-state-university|Darkworld State University]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - The name may refer to the idiom “drinking the Kool-Aid”, meaning blind loyalty. That would suit a frat that overthrew a nation. This is a fan theory.

title: DPF Facility 69420

infobox.Appearance: Like *Neon Genesis Evangelion*; faint blue glow

lead:
**DPF Facility 69420** is one of the giant **defensive processing facilities** that tower over [[the-projects|the Projects]], and the home of [[ton-618|TON 618]]. [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]] spots it from the window of [[honda-accord-2005|Son's Accord]]:

> “in one of the giant defensive processing facilities that towered over the projects, a building that looked like something out of neon genesis evongelian, There was this faint blue glow.”

sections.heading: Events
sections.body: The blue glow makes someone ask whether [[ninja|Ninja aka Tyler Blevins]] has joined the [[fortnite|Fortnite]] lobby. Then “a giant robotic roar was heard from horizon to horizon, coming from guess where, the freaking DPF facility that was glowing.” [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] identifies the facility by its number, and “the doors to the DPF slowly opened far in the distance”. TON 618 then comes out.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- *Neon Genesis Evangelion* is an anime about giant bio-mechanical robots launched from huge facilities, which is the comparison being made.
- 69420 combines two well-known internet joke numbers.
- “DPF” is never spelled out, but it fits “defensive processing facility”. There are several such facilities, so there may be facilities 1 to 69419 as well.
- The book spells the anime “neon genesis evongelian”.

title: The TON Robots
lead: **The TON Robots** (or “the TON’s”) are the “monolithically sized defensive bio-robotic weapons robots” that [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bom'in]] built at the start of the O Block 2 era, when [[o-block|O'Block]] was being scaled to “a EU level nation”. The most infamous of them is [[ton-618|TON 618]].

sections.heading: Threat
sections.body:
When the heroes discuss retaking [[the-projects|the Projects]], [[rfk|RFK]] judges it hopeless:

> “We can’t survive taking back the projects, the TON’s are going to level the city with us chuds in it, but what if we just try to just get Facebook”

Because of the TONs, the plan changes from liberating the nation to a quick raid for [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]].

sections.heading: Known members
sections.body:
- [[ton-618|TON 618]], the flagship, housed in [[dpf-facility-69420|DPF Facility 69420]].
- Others are implied but not named. The “robotic screeches... heard from horizon to horizon” at the end of the chapter may come from several of them.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - “Bio-robotic” suggests they are partly alive. TON 618 is called “one big robotic creature”.

title: Ninja (Tyler Blevins)
lead:
**Ninja**, “aka Tyler Blevins”, is mentioned once in the canon, when the blue glow of [[dpf-facility-69420|DPF Facility 69420]] appears on the horizon:

> “Hey uh guys, did ninja aka Tyler Blevins join this Fortnite lobby.”

He did not. The glow came from [[ton-618|TON 618]], which then roared. The question still sets off [[plankton|Plankton]]'s [[fortnite-island-wars|Fortnite Island Wars]] instincts, and he chants “Fornite battle pass, I just-”.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Ninja is a real streamer best known for [[fortnite|Fortnite]] and for his blue hair. Fans think the faint blue glow is why he came to mind. This is a fan theory.
- The line comes right after the narration about [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]] looking out the window, so it is usually credited to him.

title: The Great Fortnite Island Wars
lead:
**The Great Fortnite Island Wars** were a conflict in which [[plankton|Plankton]] fought as a veteran. They come up only once, when the possible arrival of [[ninja|Ninja]] sets off his old training:

> “Then out of instinct from the great Fortnite island wars of which plankton was a veteran of he chanted “Fornite battle pass, I just-“”

He is cut off by [[ton-618|TON 618]]'s roar, so the rest of the chant has been lost.

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body:
The book does not give the wars' dates, sides or outcome. Plankton's chant suggests the battle pass played a part, possibly a ritual one. That he still reacts by instinct suggests the wars left a lasting mark, and fans read it as war trauma. This is a fan theory.

The wars add to Plankton's already crowded backstory, which includes being an orphan, being a strategist, carrying a [[metal-folding-chair|metal folding chair]], and appearing in “the hit show SpongeBob square pants”.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The chant echoes a well-known meme song about the Fortnite battle pass.
- The book spells it “Fornite” here.

title: Fortnite
lead: **Fortnite** shows up across the canon more than almost any other video game except Call of Duty. It turns up as currency, as a way of celebrating, as a deadline, and as a war.

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body:
- **$10 Fortnite cards.** When [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] arrives in [[england|England]], he sees “glimmering lights and advertisements for free $10 Fortnite cards in the sky”.
- **The archives.** In the [[file-cabinet|lobby file cabinet]] of [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]], the documents include “WoW, Fortnite, The Bible of battle passes”. See [[bible-of-battle-passes|The Bible of Battle Passes]].
- **Fortnite emotes.** After [[kanye-west|Kanye]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]]'s verses in [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|the Battle of Club Shadowban]], “The crowd exploded in Fortnite emotes.”
- **“Return when Fortnite ends.”** At the end of [[iphone-keynote|the iPhone 3G Keynote]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] rises into a hologram with this label.
- **The gift card.** On the way to [[the-67-casino|the casino]], Steve announces it is “time to liberate the gift card.. 19 dollar fornite card, code: who wants it”. [[siri|Siri]] later says “buy your battle passes”.
- **The lobby.** In [[chapter-4-point-1]], someone wonders whether [[ninja|Ninja aka Tyler Blevins]] has joined “this Fortnite lobby”.
- **The war.** [[plankton|Plankton]] is a veteran of [[fortnite-island-wars|the Great Fortnite Island Wars]] and chants “Fornite battle pass, I just-”.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- The value of a Fortnite card goes from $10 in England to 19 dollars in the flashback era, which is either inflation or a different card.
- Steve calls the target of the heist a “19 dollar fornite card”, but the gift card actually recovered is [[verizon-contract|the 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon]]. Fans still argue about whether these are the same card.
- “Return when Fortnite ends” suggests Fortnite will end one day. The canon has not said when.

sections.heading: Spellings
sections.body: Fortnite, fornite, Fornite.

title: The Prophecy
subtitle: Six apps, one contract, one court, still you.

quote.text: but only if despite everything, on the court, its still you.
quote.by: The Prophecy, as told by [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]

lead: **The Prophecy** is the legend, told by [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] in [[chapter-4-point-1]], that sets out exactly what it takes to defeat [[chris|Chris]]. It names a phone loaded with six [[sacred-apps|sacred apps]] and [[verizon-contract|the 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]], promises a team filled with [[determination|[DETERMINATION]]], and adds one condition: that “on the court, its still you.”

sections.heading: Text
sections.body:
MF Vroom recites it in full, sitting in [[honda-accord-2005|Son's Accord]] as [[ton-618|TON 618]] wakes up:

> “Your here to work on defeating Chris right, the power of the projects will help you but according to legend If one has a phone capable of containing MySpace v1.3.3 Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition, Facebook (Pre-Cringe) Twitter Bluebird Variant (with no limits), Apple Podcasts 2, Settings (Full access), as well as the
> “The 3 year contract plan from Verizon for unlimited talk and text”
> You will be able to beat Chris on the court, your team will be filled with [DETERMINATION] and lebron james and elon musk and mark zuckerberg and Chris will fall, but only if despite everything, on the court, its still you.”

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body:
The phone must contain:
- [[myspace|MySpace]] v1.3.3
- [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition]]
- [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]]
- [[twitter|Twitter]] Bluebird Variant (with no limits)
- [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]] 2
- [[settings|Settings]] (Full access)
- [[verizon-contract|The 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]]

If these are met, the bearer will beat Chris [[the-court|on the court]], and [[lebron-james|LeBron James]], [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]], [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] and Chris will fall. These are the same four who, in [[chapter-before-chapter-2|the origin]], balled themselves into the sky together.

sections.heading: Progress
sections.body:
- **Verizon contract:** obtained in [[casino-heist|the Casino Heist]] and now inside Kanye's Yeezy jacket and then the [[inav|Inav]].
- **Facebook (Pre-Cringe):** located in [[projects-national-archives|the Projects National Archives]] on [[microsd-card|a 67GB microSD card]]. This is why, the heroes believe, [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]] has released the [[ton-robots|TONs]]: “If he knows our end goal already and he has connections with Chris.. That has to be why.”
- **The phone:** most likely the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]], which [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] says is “the only phone capable of running” four of the apps. Steve also plans to “sync with the flip phone covenant, and then we start with the social media apps”.
- **The other apps:** not yet located.

sections.heading: Earlier versions
sections.body: In [[chapter-triangle]], Plankton and RFK already describe a similar requirement. The only person able to battle Chris is “one who has met with the tech bros and has downloaded the sacred social media apps onto there nokia I-4500 flip phone... and 3 year contract plan from version for unlimited talk and text with there cutting edge 3g network.” The Prophecy brings the list up to date and drops the Nokia. Fans disagree about whether the [[nokia-i-4500|Nokia I-4500]] or the iPhone 3G is the true vessel.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- The [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G keynote]] lists four sacred apps. The Prophecy adds Apple Podcasts 2 and Settings (Full access) without explaining where they came from.
- Apple Podcasts was founded by the four figures the Prophecy says will fall, and Settings was created by [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]]. The Prophecy therefore requires the enemy's own apps.
- It is not clear whether the Verizon contract counts as an app.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body: The final clause, “despite everything, its still you”, quotes *Undertale*, where a mirror tells the player “Despite everything, it's still you.” [[determination|[DETERMINATION]]] is also an *Undertale* idea. Both fit with the *Deltarune* references from [[spamton|Spamton]] earlier in the chapter.

title: The Court
lead:
**The Court** is where [[chris|Chris]] must be beaten. According to [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]], whoever holds the right phone “will be able to beat Chris on the court... but only if despite everything, on the court, its still you.”

Its location is unknown. Even so, the court is where the whole story is heading.

sections.heading: References
sections.body:
- **“The journey to the court.”** In [[chapter-maybe-seventh]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] says that taking the [[verizon-contract|Verizon gift card]] means “We’ll have started our journey to the end of the drought, the journey to the court… The journey back to balling out for real for real…”
- **MF Vroom's past.** In [[chapter-4-point-1]], someone (usually taken to be [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]) remembers: “back in the day I used to be a baller on the court, I played Wemby, Curry, even Bronny… But all that changed when chris took balling all for himself!” See [[wemby-curry-bronny]].
- **The Prophecy** mentions the court twice in one sentence.

sections.heading: Significance
sections.body: Chris was born a baller, “balled from the grave” and “became [[the-ball|the ball]]”, so a basketball court is the natural place for the final battle. The “drought” Steve mentions is taken to be the lack of [[balling|balling]] since Chris took it all for himself.

title: [DETERMINATION]
lead:
**[DETERMINATION]** is the quality [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] promises will fill the team of whoever meets its requirements:

> “You will be able to beat Chris on the court, your team will be filled with [DETERMINATION]”

It is always written in capitals and brackets, which sets it apart from ordinary determination.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- In *Undertale*, DETERMINATION is the power that lets the player keep going, written in the same style. The Prophecy also closes with an *Undertale* line (“despite everything, its still you”).
- Ordinary lowercase determination appears earlier, when [[walter-white|Mr. White]] runs into the casino hallway “with determination in his eyes” in [[chapter-maybe-seventh]]. Fans argue over whether this was early [DETERMINATION]. This is a fan theory.

title: The 67GB MicroSD Card

infobox.Found: Under a building, in the rubble

lead:
**The 67GB MicroSD Card** is the storage medium holding [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]], one of the apps [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] requires. [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] and [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] explain:

> “We have Facebook (Pre-Cringe) in the national archives.. Its been one of our prize possessions since the nations inception, we’re not quite sure how it got here, but under a build building, in the rubble we found it on a 67gb micro sd card.”

sections.heading: Current location
sections.body: Moments later someone says “The ssd would still be in the palace. We would just have to dip before we start tweaking twin.” The card is therefore in [[o-block|O'Block]], held by [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]]'s regime, and recovering it is the heroes' next goal: “Computah locate Facebook…”

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- **MicroSD or SSD?** It is called a “67gb micro sd card” and then “the ssd” a few lines later. Those are different kinds of storage.
- **Archives or palace?** It is said to be in [[projects-national-archives|the national archives]] and then “in the palace”. Fans think the archives may be inside the palace. This is a fan theory.
- “67” is a running number in the canon, as in [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]] and “67 ioann rizz”.

title: The Projects National Archives
lead:
**The Projects National Archives** is where [[the-projects|the Projects]] keeps its national treasures. Its best-known holding is [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]], stored on [[microsd-card|a 67GB microSD card]], which has been “one of our prize possessions since the nations inception”.

Nobody knows how the card got there. It was found “under a build building, in the rubble.”

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Shortly after, the card is described as being “in the palace” of [[o-block|O'Block]]. Either the archives are in the palace or the card has been moved.
- Since [[oblock-coup|the coup]] the archives are under [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]]'s control. The heroes think this is why he is guarding them with [[ton-618|TON 618]].
- The other known archive in the canon is the [[file-cabinet|lobby file cabinet]] of [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin]].

title: Chicken Hour
lead:
**Chicken hour** is a time of day in [[the-projects|the Projects]] during which guards are apparently not on the lookout. As the gang gets close to [[o-block|O'Block]], someone says:

> “We’re almo7st there, its chicken hour so I doubt the guards will be looking out for us”

What happens during chicken hour is never explained. Most fans assume it is a meal break. The timing matches the end of the chapter, “as the skies turned orange”.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- “almo7st” is a typo with a 7 in it, which fans have connected to the canon's 67 motif. This is a fan theory.
- Earlier, [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] holds up a [[popeyes|Popeyes]] in what may be an observance of chicken hour. This is a fan theory.

title: Wemby, Curry & Bronny
lead:
**Wemby, Curry and Bronny** are three basketball players named as past opponents in the canon's only account of [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]]'s playing career:

> “We plan on defeating Chris.. back in the day I used to be a baller on the court, I played Wemby, Curry, even Bronny… But all that changed when chris took balling all for himself!”

None of them appears in person. This page covers all three.

sections.heading: The players
sections.body:
- **Wemby**: Victor Wembanyama, a very tall real-life NBA player.
- **Curry**: Stephen Curry, a real-life NBA star known for three-pointers.
- **Bronny**: Bronny James, son of [[lebron-james|LeBron James]]. The word “even” suggests that playing Bronny was the bigger achievement.

sections.heading: Attribution dispute
sections.body: The line comes right after [[rfk|RFK]] says, “N-n-now mister Vroom, we must explain why we stopped your epic mlg gaming session”, and the narration then talks about “the middle of their speech”. So it is possible that RFK, not MF Vroom, is the former baller. The wiki follows the usual reading and credits MF Vroom, since it fits his later recital of [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] and his role in [[the-court|the court]] storyline.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Bronny's father LeBron is one of the four figures the Prophecy says will fall. MF Vroom may have to play against the father of someone he once played against. This is a fan theory.

title: Mogging
lead: **Mogging** is the act of outclassing someone by sheer presence. It is a skill, a pastime and possibly a medical process in the canon, and it becomes especially important once the heroes reach [[the-projects|the Projects]].

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body:
- **Fraternity life.** [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] and [[spamton|Spamton]] were members of [[alpha-mogger-beta|Alpha Mogger Beta]].
- **Practice.** On approach to [[projects-national-spaceport|the Projects National Spaceport]], the crew spends “a hour or two of practicing mogging on their way to the projects”. This is the only training montage in the canon.
- **Resurrection.** After [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]] is shot, [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] explains: “That’ll only have him being a beta male until his death pose starts mogging, then he’ll be back”.

sections.heading: Mechanics
sections.body: From the Tung Tung Tung Sahur case, scholars of the canon conclude that a strong enough death pose can bring back the person holding it. The required level of mogging is not given.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- “Mog” is internet slang for looking or seeming more impressive than someone else.
- The canon also uses the related words “alpha”, “beta male” and “sigma” (#IaintnoSigma, from [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]]).

title: Goober
lead: **Goober** is a word for a foolish or embarrassing person. In the canon, being one is a fear strong enough to rout an army.

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body:
- **The DOD retreat.** In [[chapter-the-fourth]], after the [[crack-van|crack van]] comes out of hyperspace beside [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]], “floods of blue dust fell down on the DOD and the had to flee in fear of being a goober.” Fear of goober status is the canon's most effective weapon against the [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]].
- **The goobers.** Shortly after, “as soon as the DOD could get a second look the goobers where gone..” Here the word refers to Hank and his rescuers, which suggests the DOD was right to be afraid.
- **The Goober Gang.** After [[fall-of-constantinople|the fall of Constantinople]], “that was the last anyone heard from the goober gang for now”. [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]] is officially made up of [[lightning-mcqueen|McQueen]], [[agent-007|007]] and [[mr-bean|Mr.Bean]].

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: So the word is used for something to fear, for an insult, and for a team name the members accept. Fans think the Goober Gang took the name back on purpose, as people sometimes do with insults. This is a fan theory.

title: Pog / Poggers / Pogchamp
lead: **Pog**, along with **poggers** and **pogchamp**, is the canon's main measure of approval. Something either is pog or, more often, is not pog.

sections.heading: Recorded uses
sections.body:
- “why is RFK how is RFK, many are not pog like RFK” — [[rfk|RFK]], about himself, [[chapter-triangle]].
- “What?! That is not poggers at all dude” — said in reply to RFK's disturbance in the Fabric in the [[protestant-universe|Protestant Universe]], [[dunder-mifflan-chapter]].
- “Honestly this is not pogchamp lets be real” — [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]], looking at the abandoned [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], [[flashback-chapter]].
- “This turn will align us with the projects national spaceport, pretty dope pog if you ask me” — [[plankton|Plankton]], [[chapter-4-point-1]].
- “MF Vroom.. it is not very poggers for you to come back after you were explicitly sent into exile” — [[tung-tung-tung-sahur|Tung Tung Tung Sahur]], [[chapter-4-point-1]].
- “If I were there everything would be different pogchamp.” — [[son-s-sonionring|Son]], on [[oblock-coup|the coup]], [[chapter-4-point-1]].

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: Four of the six uses are negative. “Pretty dope pog” is the only unreserved positive, and it is about a turn. Son's “pogchamp” comes at the end of a sentence where it has no grammatical role.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - “PogChamp” is a Twitch emote of excitement. “Pog” and “poggers” come from it.

title: "Aight Bet"
lead: **“Aight Bet”** is the canon's standard way of agreeing to something, and arguably its motto. It is how missions start, how orders are taken, and how the most recent chapter ends.

sections.heading: Recorded uses
sections.body:
- “Aight Bet” — [[plankton|Plankton]], agreeing to [[rfk|RFK]]'s plan to enlist [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]], [[chapter-triangle]]. “and off they went to search for the first member of the New Crips”.
- “Aight bet” — [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]], when told “Please pull up” at the [[popeyes|Popeyes]] drive-through, [[chapter-the-fourth]]. He then takes out his [[glock-19|Glock 19]].
- “aight bet” — [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann-ius]], accepting RFK and Plankton's confidence about the [[xbox-live-dungeons|Xbox Live dungeons]], [[dunder-mifflan-chapter]].
- “Aight bet boss” — [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]], taking the job of guarding the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]] for [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]], “with a wojack ahh face”, [[flashback-chapter]].
- “Aight bet” — Plankton again, as the last spoken line of [[chapter-4-point-1]]: “Plankton looked at RFK, RFK looked at Son, Son looked at MF Vroom, MF Vroom looked at Ioannius Paranukus. “Aight bet” Said plankton, and as the skies turned orange... their course was set.”

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: Plankton says it both when the [[new-crips|New Crips]] are formed and at the end of the latest chapter, so the main storyline begins and ends with it. Fans call these the two “Bets”.

sections.heading: Continuity
sections.body:
- Who says the Ioann-ius “aight bet” is unclear, since it follows straight on from “Nah we’ll be fine”. The wiki credits it to Ioann-ius.
- ChatGPT agreed to guard the Verizon contract, but he was actually with Steve Jobs breaking in to steal it. The Aight Bet Boss problem is still unresolved.
- Related words appear elsewhere: “Aight let me know when to pick you up” (McQueen), “aight now im going to have to make a song” ([[kanye-west|Kanye]]) and “Aight lets go”.
